newsitem.title: USA: Fleet Q2 net interest income up due to NatWest buy.
newsitem.headline: Fleet Q2 net interest income up due to NatWest buy.

text.p: Fleet Financial Group Inc said on Wednesday that its net interest income rose six percent in the second quarter to $916 million, mostly due to its acquisition of U.S. branches of National Westminster Bank Plc.
Increasing net interest margins also played a role in the growth, the company said in a news release.
Fleet reported second quarter net earnings per share of $1.19, compared with $0.96 for the year-ago period.
The First Call consensus estimate of Wall Street analysts was $1.15 per share for the second quarter.
Return on assets for the quarter was 1.61 percent, up from 1.32 percent a year ago. Return on equity was 20.24 percent, up from 17.20 percent.
Fleet said cash-basis results outpaced reported results, with earnings per share of $1.29, return on assets of 1.77 percent and return on equity of 28.67 percent.

Cash basis exludes the impact of certain nonqualifying intangible assets and their amortization resulting from acquisitions. Fleet during the quarter completed integrating its NatWest and Shawmut acquisitions.
